[[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]35 (Sandbox) |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Average (3.25) |cash = {{Money|30}} on death |spawned_by = [[Mother Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Mother Ducky]] |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = {{Attr|Health Regen}} |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Child Conscription}}''' - Upon its destruction, the '''Eggroll 3''' spawns one [[Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Ducky]]. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Eggroll 3''', which uses the display name of '''Eggroll''', was a small enemy that appeared in [[Bathroom Approach]] as part of the [[Ducky Revenge Event]] and its rerun in the [[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]]. It has average health, above average speed and [[Health Regen]]. It can be spawned by the [[Mother Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Mother Ducky]] upon its death. Upon its destruction, it spawns the [[Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Ducky]]. ==Appearance== The '''Eggroll 3''' is a dark green egg with blue, white and green wavy patterns with white speckles that rolls the surface on the path. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Bathroom Approach]] is listed instead. *The '''Eggroll 3''' always spawns alongside other eggrolls and summons an enemy on death. **Area of effect towers, like the [[Mortar]], [[Pyromancer]] or [[Rocketeer]] can be useful here because of this, as they can damage all the eggrolls at once. **Single target towers like the [[Cowboy]], [[Engineer]] or [[Ace Pilot]] can also be helpful. *Later on, high DPS towers like the [[Pursuit]], [[Minigunner]] or [[Ranger]] can deal with it easily. *The [[Hacker]] can be used to prevent the '''Eggroll 3''' from summoning anything on death. **Due to it having [[Health Regen]] by default, it will actually keep regenerating health even when converted, making it especially useful to convert. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1Egg3.png|Green variant, current version, first animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseEggroll3.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (16 April 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} Eggroll3IconIG.png|'''Eggroll 3''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Eggroll 3''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''16 April 2025''' -
